biotools.summary: CellPhePy is a Python implementation of the CellPhe toolkit for automated cell phenotyping from microscopy time-lapse videos. It provides functions for feature extraction, time-series analysis, and cell type classification, building on the original R package and offering enhanced capabilities like improved feature identification and multiclass classification.
